changes: Found a genuinely different Hold'em bug from a live error report: "Something went wrong. (Cannot read properties of null (reading 'stack'))" when deleting a table with 2 people seated — and importantly, that table was NOT stuck at 'hand_in_progress', so this isn't the same bug fixed a few versions back. holdem-dealer.mjs's own deleteTable action is throwing server-side while refunding seated players, and that file isn't available to edit directly here.

Admin's delete button now always routes through the already-working adminForceDeleteTable action instead of the original (proven unreliable) deleteTable — in both places it can be triggered: the trash icon directly on the table list, and the delete button inside an open table's own view. Non-admin table creators still go through the original action and could still hit this bug — there's no fix available for that case without access to holdem-dealer.mjs itself.
